blocks.content: 6. The return value of Fibonacci(2) is stored in the dictionary.
Now, Fibonacci(2) finally calculates the dictionary value fib[2]:
This value is then returned to Fibonacci(3).

blocks.alt: Store Return Value of Fibonacci(2) in Dictionary

blocks.content: Also, since the value is now in the dictionary, it will be used automatically whenever Fibonacci(2) is called by later instances of the recursive function.
